title: Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.01297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. translated_title: 问卷引导的家用智能电表数据电器用电分解
translated_abstract: 爱尔兰的智能电表计划以30分钟为分辨率记录用电量，截至2025年底已在超过80%的家庭中安装了智能电表。虽然这种分辨率对于智能分时电价的计费很有用，但对于捕捉家用电器的使用情况来说过于粗糙。我们提出了一种无标签的分解系统，通过将针对大功率负载的事件检测与问卷引导的估计相结合，将用电数据分解为9个电器类别。我们的评估基于四个数据集：一个配备商用对比系统的校准家庭、两个带有逐电器分项计量的公开基准数据集（UK-DALE和REFIT），以及一个来自2,968名爱尔兰消费者、包含超过4,800年用电数据的智能电表数据集。与两个独立开发的分解系统相比，我们这种结合用电数据分析与问卷结果的混合方法，在所有数据集的所有建筑上均实现了最低的整体分解误差。
tldr: 提出了一种无标签的用电分解方法，通过结合大功率负载事件检测与问卷引导估计，将30分钟分辨率的智能电表数据分解为9类电器用电，并在四个数据集上取得了最低的整体分解误差。
en_tdlr: A label-free disaggregation system combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation breaks 30-minute smart meter data into 9 appliance categories, achieving the lowest whole-decomposition error across four datasets.
